授業科目の概要.講義題目: Blue Humanities and Storied Seas: Intersections of Literature, Science, and the Oceans
授業科目の概要.対象学部等: 共創学部/School of Interdisciplinary Science and Innovation
授業科目の概要.曜日時限: 冬学期 水曜日 ３時限

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course will introduce students to the complex and evolving relationship between humanity and the oceans through integrated approaches drawn from the humanities and sciences. It will examine how the oceans are known through a combination of narratives, from literature to the sciences. Students will learn to engage with data from the humanities and the sciences, recognizing that both epistemological perspectives and approaches are necessary to begin to understand the foundationally important relationship between humans and the oceans. By employing multi- and transdisciplinary approaches, students will analyze the ways in which narratives shape our relationship with the ocean.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Blue Humanities, maritime cultures, ocean-human relations, climate change, maritime literature, sustainability, marine ethnography.
